<div id="p1" class="ltx_para">
<span class="ltx_ERROR undefined">\section</span>
<p class="ltx_p">*Week 3 — Topological Spaces</p>
</div>
<div id="p2" class="ltx_para">
<span class="ltx_ERROR undefined">{definition}</span>
<p class="ltx_p">A <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">topological space</em> is a set <math id="p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="X" display="inline"><mi>X</mi></math> together with a collection <math id="p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{T}" display="inline"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi></math> of subsets of <math id="p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="X" display="inline"><mi>X</mi></math>, called <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">open sets</em>, satisfying:</p>
<ol id="section0.I1" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="section0.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="section0.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p"><math id="section0.I1.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\emptyset\in\mathcal{T}" display="inline"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">∅</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi></mrow></math> and <math id="section0.I1.i1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="X\in\mathcal{T}" display="inline"><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi></mrow></math>.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="section0.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="section0.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Arbitrary unions of members of <math id="section0.I1.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{T}" display="inline"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi></math> belong to <math id="section0.I1.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{T}" display="inline"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi></math>.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li id="section0.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;">
<span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<div id="section0.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p class="ltx_p">Finite intersections of members of <math id="section0.I1.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{T}" display="inline"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi></math> belong to <math id="section0.I1.i3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{T}" display="inline"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi></math>.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</article>
